evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.brierTooltip: Brier Score — lower = better calibrated (0 = perfect, 0.667 = random)

perf.uniqueHint: When several archives point to the same selection in a match it counts as one decision; the archive breakdown shows each archive separately.
perf.liveOldHint: Rule used until 18 Oct: per-archive 85%+ signals, including samples under 5 matches. Shown ~98% but hit ~66%, so it was replaced; its history stays here.
perf.prematchShadowHint: The on-screen rule until 19 Oct. No longer shown but still recorded for every match, to compare with Dixon-Coles (v5).
perf.verdictHint: Protocol: no rule changes before 100 unique decisions. If the upper end of the 95% interval stays below the shown probability, the market is suspended (new version + shadow). No odds data, so no profitability claims.
perf.liftHint: Versus the baseline pick on the same matches (HT baseline for live)
perf.calibrationHint: Average shown probability versus actual hit rate
perf.stage_cok_erken: Too early — small sample, not reliable yet
perf.stage_on_bulgu: Preliminary — will firm up as the sample grows
perf.emptyLive: Live predictions are recorded automatically at half-time; they will appear here as matches are played.
perf.emptyDay: No recorded predictions for this day.
perf.backtestNote: Backtest: what today's rules would have said on past matches — each match only sees data known at that moment (no leakage). Never mixed with recorded predictions; real performance is on the Live HT and Pre-match tabs.
perf.noRuns: No backtest runs yet (created with the backtest-ledger command).
perf.informationalHint: Not in Top Picks — measured only, as it does not beat the league average.
perf.marketSummaryHint: Each archive's top selection per market (no threshold) — measured only, not a recommendation.
perf.chartAria: Calibration chart: shown probability vs observed hit rate; the diagonal is perfect calibration.
perf.emptyLiveDay: No recorded live matches on this day.
perf.liveSummaryNote: On-screen live decision since 27 October: team strength model (live-poisson-v1.1), markets at 85%+ at half-time, one decision per market. Marked hit/miss when the match ends.
perf.htHint: HT double chance, HT 1/2, HT goal, HT under 1.5, HT home goal — team strength model; no verdict before 100 decisions.
perf.liveV2Hint: The on-screen decision from 19 to 27 October; now shown next to the team strength decision as confirmation and still measured.
perf.livePoissonV1Hint: Not on screen from 19 to 27 October, recorded in the background. These records are the basis for putting it on screen. Difference from v1.1: it also had FT under 2.5 (removed because it showed 87.7% but hit 83.6% historically).

live.title: Live
live.htDescription: Half-time and second-half matches: results of pre-match A1/A2/A3 matches that had the same HT score. Rates above 85% on top; samples under 5 matches are marked risky.
live.noLiveMatches: No top-league match is at half-time or in the second half right now.
live.noLiveNote: When matches reach half-time, archive rates appear here and 85%+ signals are recorded at that moment.

prediction.title: Full-time prediction
prediction.frozenTooltip: This prediction was recorded immutably at half-time; its result is tracked on the Evaluation page.
prediction.archivesNote: Secondary information — less reliable than the main prediction because samples are small.

archive.noDecisions: No decision meets the rule for this match
archive.decisionRule: Rule: an archive with at least {min} matches says {pct}%+ AND past matches in the same league with the same half-time score also say {pct}%+. The shown rate is the league history rate; the archive rate is next to it. One decision per market.
archive.condTooltip: Rate of this selection in {n} past matches with the same half-time score (realistic estimate).
archive.conflictTooltip: Archives pointed to different selections; the archive with the largest sample won.
archive.riskyTooltip: This archive has {n} matches (under {min}) — small sample, the rate may be high by chance.
archive.generalNote: General = union of A1+A2+A3 matches (each match counted once). Markets already decided by the HT score are hidden.
archive.frozenTooltip: 85%+ signals were recorded immutably at half-time; their results are tracked under Evaluation → Live HT.
archive.noAnalysis: This match was not analysed before kickoff (happens if the morning pipeline did not run) — no archive rates or records.
archive.historicalTooltip: In the historical test, 85%+ signals in this market with {bucket}-match samples actually hit this often ({n} signals).
archive.historicalPooled: Not enough data for this market, so the average of all markets with the same sample size is used.
archive.historicalNote: "past X%": the real hit rate of the same kind of signal in past matches — the shown rate looks inflated when the sample is small.
archive.poissonRule: Expected goals for the remaining 45 minutes from team strength (Poisson). Markets at 85%+ are shown; the rate in past matches from the same league with the same half-time score is next to it. One decision per market.
archive.poissonNone: The model has no 85%+ decision for this match
archive.confirmedTooltip: The archive + league history rule (live-arch-v2) made the same pick. In the past, decisions where both rules agreed hit 93.5% of the time.
archive.historicalMarketTooltip: Actual hit rate of this market's decisions in the historical test (2023-07 → today, leak-free) ({n} decisions).

live.staleTooltip: Live data has not updated for {s}s; the source may be delayed.

topPicks.title: Pre-match pick
topPicks.emptyMessage: No pick meets the publishing rule for this match (pool ≥30 matches and a probability at least 5 points above the league average). Detailed archive statistics are shown below for information.
topPicks.disclaimer: The pick is frozen before kickoff and its result is tracked on the Evaluation page. The percentage is the A1+A2+A3 pooled probability shrunk to the last-3-season league average; in backtests the shown probability matches the actual hit rate.
topPicks.emptyMessageV5: No selection meets the publishing rule for this match: the team-strength model sees no win at least 10 points above the league average (draws are not published). Detailed archive statistics are shown below for information.
topPicks.disclaimerV5: The selection is fixed before kick-off and tracked on the Evaluation page. The percentage is the probability from a Dixon-Coles model built on the teams' goal output over the last 3 years. In the historical test 62.7% of 3,019 selections won while the average shown was 58.6% (the model does not overstate). Strong signal = the archive pool agrees.
topPicks.priorLine: League average {prior}% · {edge} pts above league average
topPicks.settingsChanged: This pick was frozen before kickoff with different archive settings; the archive percentages below use the current settings, so they may not match exactly.

ht.note: Probability is computed from the odds with the bookmaker margin removed; historically this was the most accurate estimate. Our team strength model did not beat the odds in the first half (in a 1,205-match test, "value" picks lost money), so there is no value claim — the model probability is shown only as a note.
